description.value:
The Gria are a race of winged humanoids distinguished by draconic features and native to the region of Jylland, driven by a love for battle.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Gria gain +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, and –2 Wisdom.
  • Type: Gria are Humanoid creatures with the gria subtype.
  • Size: Gria are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
  • Base Speed: Gria have a base speed of 30 feet on land, with limited flight (clumsy) for a number of rounds equal to their Constitution bonus.
  • Languages: Gria begin play speaking Common and Draconic. Gria with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Banganese, Giant, Goblin, Ignan, Seeq, Terran.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Fearless: Gria receive a +2 racial bonus on saves against fear spells and effects.
  • Stubborn: Gria gain a +2 racial bonus on Will saving throws to resist illusion spells and effects, with a chance to end the effect early.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Athleticism: Gria receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks.
  • Diplomatic: Gria receive a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks.
  • Survivalist: Gria receive a +2 racial bonus on Survival checks.
  • Martial Background: Gria receive Weapon Focus for free at first level.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Destructive: Gria receive a +2 racial bonus on sunder combat maneuver checks.
  • Weapon Familiarity: Gria are proficient with the knight sword and longbow (including composite).

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Gria can see twice as far as humes in dim light.
